jobsmenu.interfaz.multijugador.subtitulo: Crew registry and available access points
jobsmenu.interfaz.video.subtitulo: Image and visibility parameters for the room
jobsmenu.interfaz.idioma.subtitulo: Language of facility records and notices
jobsmenu.subtitulo: NOTICE TO THE OCCUPANTS OF THIS LEVEL
jobsmenu.aviso.0: The exit exists. The amount due is listed in your file.
jobsmenu.aviso.1: Worked time cannot be returned. Every completed shift remains on record.
jobsmenu.aviso.2: Accumulated balance is used only to authorize departure.
jobsmenu.aviso.3: If the facility hum stops suddenly, do not move until it returns.
jobsmenu.aviso.4: Executors do not respond to negotiation, orders, or warnings.
jobsmenu.aviso.5: Do not announce the Level number aloud.
jobsmenu.aviso.6: Do not cross access points marked closed even when the door is open.
jobsmenu.aviso.7: Remain at your assigned post for the duration of the shift.
jobsmenu.aviso.8: Exit fees vary by Level. Read the notice before moving on.
jobsmenu.aviso.9: If a light fails directly above you, move aside and continue waiting.
jobsmenu.aviso.10: Internal exits lead to other areas of the facility.
jobsmenu.aviso.11: Do not use an open service door without authorization.
jobsmenu.aviso.12: Questions are recorded even when no answer is issued.
jobsmenu.aviso.13: Keep your shift record available for inspection.
jobsmenu.aviso.14: Do not drink from tanks, pools, or unmarked pipes.
jobsmenu.aviso.15: If activity is heard outside your sector, wait before proceeding.
jobsmenu.aviso.16: The elevator is out of service. Use authorized access routes only.
jobsmenu.aviso.17: No closing time has been assigned to your shift.
jobsmenu.aviso.18: Do not leave food or personal belongings in the corridors.
jobsmenu.aviso.19: Power cuts are part of maintenance. Remain in your sector.
jobsmenu.aviso.especial.anonuevo: Happy new year. The level is the same. So are you.
jobsmenu.aviso.especial.difuntos: Today the niches count themselves. Do not help.
jobsmenu.aviso.especial.madrugada: It is three o'clock. At this hour the corridor listens better.
jobsmenu.aviso.especial.viernes13: Today the administration advises against trusting the numbers.
jobsmenu.aviso.especial.trabajador: Today labour is commemorated. You, as every day, perform it.
jobsmenu.aviso.especial.navidad: Season's greetings. The administration does not close. Nor does it open.
jobsmenu.aviso.especial.medianoche: It is midnight. The shift changes. You do not change with it.
jobsmenu.nivel0.nota0: No marked exit. The wallpaper never ends.
jobsmenu.nivel0.nota1: The offices closed. The phones did not: they still ring.
jobsmenu.nivel0.nota2: Every occupant was filed away. The file is on this floor.
jobsmenu.nivel1.nota0: There is far too much room for one person.
jobsmenu.nivel1.nota1: Inventory reads zero. Someone took even the shadows.
jobsmenu.nivel1.nota2: The crates are empty and heavy all the same. Do not move them.
jobsmenu.nivel2.nota0: The pipes are still warm. Nobody turned them on.
jobsmenu.nivel2.nota1: The water runs upward in the stretch you cannot see.
jobsmenu.nivel2.nota2: If the dripping keeps your rhythm, change corridors.
jobsmenu.nivel3.nota0: The water is lukewarm. The echo takes too long to come back.
jobsmenu.nivel3.nota1: No one has swum here in years and the pool is still full.
jobsmenu.nivel3.nota2: The diving board moved. You did not touch it.
jobsmenu.nivel4.nota0: Someone lit the torches. There is no one to have done it.
jobsmenu.nivel4.nota1: The chandelier sways when the unseen thing passes.
jobsmenu.nivel4.nota2: One place at the table is set. It is yours.
jobsmenu.nivel5.nota0: The books are in an order. Not ours.
jobsmenu.nivel5.nota1: A single volume is missing from every shelf. Always the same number.
jobsmenu.nivel5.nota2: Someone left a lamp on. Someone always does.
jobsmenu.nivel6.nota0: The plants grew with no one to water them.
jobsmenu.nivel6.nota1: Light comes in through the roof. There is no roof outside.
jobsmenu.nivel6.nota2: Something moves among the leaves when you breathe.
jobsmenu.nivel7.nota0: The niches are numbered. So is yours.
jobsmenu.nivel7.nota1: Someone keeps the candles lit. Count how many there are.
jobsmenu.nivel7.nota2: The lantern moves without wind. You did not blow either.
jobsmenu.nivel8.nota0: The water has no visible bottom. It has none.
jobsmenu.nivel8.nota1: Count the columns on the way in. Count them on the way out.
jobsmenu.nivel8.nota2: Your reflection takes a moment too long to copy you.
jobsmenu.nivel9.nota0: The throne is empty. It always was, they say.
jobsmenu.nivel9.nota1: The crown is gone. The hollow where it sat is not.
jobsmenu.nivel9.nota2: You sit for a moment and the whole hall goes quiet.
jobsmenu.subtitulo.evento.nivel3_ondas: The water moves on its own
jobsmenu.pausa.subtitulo: YOUR SHIFT HAS BEEN HALTED. THE ADMINISTRATION HAS NOTED IT.
jobsmenu.ajustes.boton.detalle: Jobs Menu visual, audio, and accessibility preferences.
jobsmenu.ajustes.escena.detalle: The corridor breathes and the light flickers. Off, the scene stays still; the room sound keeps playing as usual.
jobsmenu.ajustes.alto.detalle: Strengthens ink, paper and silhouettes without using alert colours.
jobsmenu.ajustes.grande.detalle: Increases type and spacing when the window has enough room.
jobsmenu.ajustes.papel.detalle: Removes decorative tape and shadow while keeping the document and borders.
jobsmenu.ajustes.guia.detalle: Subtly marks the row that has focus.
jobsmenu.ajustes.estado.detalle: Shows whether the room is normal, transferring or suspended.
jobsmenu.ajustes.respiracion.detalle: Moves the vanishing point very slowly without changing other animation.
jobsmenu.ajustes.rotar.detalle: The background changes level on its own, with the blackout in between. With this on, the F key on the notice shows the next room right away.
jobsmenu.ajustes.rotacioncalma.detalle: Each level stays twice as long before the blackout.
jobsmenu.ajustes.duracion.detalle: Reading time for each rotating note, between 4 and 15 seconds.
jobsmenu.ajustes.nivelfijo.detalle: Level shown while automatic transfers are disabled.
jobsmenu.ajustes.cuenta.detalle: The countdown in the corner. Useless, but it runs.
jobsmenu.ajustes.avisos.detalle: The line that keeps changing at the foot of the sheet.
jobsmenu.ajustes.fecha.detalle: Stamps the date at the foot of the sheet, like a document.
jobsmenu.ajustes.interfaz.detalle: Leaves only the essentials: no sheet, no clock, no notes.
jobsmenu.ajustes.volaviso.detalle: Governs the music, the room and the gestures. The M key in the notice toggles silence.
jobsmenu.ajustes.volmusica.detalle: The menu theme. It plays on the master channel, not Music.
jobsmenu.ajustes.volambiente.detalle: The air, the water and the level's noises. It plays even with a still scene, on the notice channel, not Ambient.
jobsmenu.ajustes.musica.detalle: The theme playing beneath everything else.
jobsmenu.ajustes.ambiente.detalle: The level's ambience: air, water, the plant and its stray noises.
jobsmenu.ajustes.botones.detalle: The sound of running over and marking the lines.
jobsmenu.ajustes.credito.detalle: The music author's credit, as it begins to play.
jobsmenu.ajustes.movimiento.detalle: Turns off suspended dust and what shows at the far end of the room.
jobsmenu.ajustes.destellos.detalle: Freezes the light's flicker and the alert pulse.
jobsmenu.ajustes.presencia.detalle: Allows the ambiguous silhouette and its distant reflections.
jobsmenu.ajustes.eventos.detalle: Allows sweeps, humidity, dust and brief changes in the room.
jobsmenu.ajustes.suspension.detalle: Allows the building's rare prolonged blackout.
jobsmenu.ajustes.menu.detalle: Replaces the game's title screen with the level notice.
jobsmenu.ajustes.pausa.detalle: Replaces the game's pause with the suspended stay.
jobsmenu.ajustes.bajoconsumo.detalle: Turns off dust, grain, the figure and camera breathing for modest hardware. The room and its sound remain intact.
jobsmenu.ajustes.estancia.detalle: Seconds each level stays before the blackout, from 15 to 90.
jobsmenu.ajustes.perfil.detalle: Combines reduced motion, reduced flashes, high contrast and large text. Toggling any of the four by hand disables the profile.
jobsmenu.nivel10.nota0: The chains are under tension. Administration does not record what they hold.
jobsmenu.nivel10.nota1: Red indicates Executor presence. It does not indicate distance.
jobsmenu.nivel10.nota2: Do not touch the links. Not even when they stop moving.
jobsmenu.nivel11.nota0: The vegetation grows toward the green lights. The lights give no heat.
jobsmenu.nivel11.nota1: The amber lamps remain lit. No personnel are assigned here.
jobsmenu.nivel11.nota2: There is a route at the far end. Administration does not confirm that it returns.
jobsmenu.nivel12.nota0: The green beacons mark an installation absent from every plan.
jobsmenu.nivel12.nota1: The room answers with an echo before you make a sound.
jobsmenu.nivel12.nota2: Do not remain in the centre. The centre is already occupied.
jobsmenu.nivel13.nota0: The chandelier remains lit. The watch ended a long time ago.
jobsmenu.nivel13.nota1: The banners identify no registered crew.
jobsmenu.nivel13.nota2: The tunnel at the far end counts as an exit only after payment.
jobsmenu.nivel14.nota0: The gate is operational. Opening does not mean crossing.
jobsmenu.nivel14.nota1: The green markings are for service. Nobody remembers which service.
jobsmenu.nivel14.nota2: If every beacon goes dark at once, do not wait for them to return.
jobsmenu.nivel15.nota0: The red field is not decorative. Administration recommends reducing your silhouette.
jobsmenu.nivel15.nota1: The lines move when nobody watches. They move faster when somebody does.
jobsmenu.nivel15.nota2: Executor interference was recorded. Distance could not be established.
jobsmenu.nivel16.nota0: The prism has no inventory number. It still appears on every list.
jobsmenu.nivel16.nota1: Do not use reflections to count occupants. They do not agree.
jobsmenu.nivel16.nota2: The white geometry does not mark an exit. Administration checked twice.
jobsmenu.nivel17.nota0: The figure was there before the room was lit.
jobsmenu.nivel17.nota1: Do not confuse a still silhouette with an empty silhouette.
jobsmenu.nivel17.nota2: The blue light reaches the far end. That does not mean the far end stops there.
jobsmenu.tooltip.piel: Change your model, arm and visible skin layers.
jobsmenu.tooltip.sonido: Adjust music, ambience, blocks, creatures and devices.
jobsmenu.tooltip.video: Configure distance, graphics, particles and performance.
jobsmenu.tooltip.controles: Review mouse, sensitivity and key assignments.
jobsmenu.tooltip.idioma: Search and apply the language used by every label.
jobsmenu.tooltip.chat: Configure chat size, background, links and notices.
jobsmenu.tooltip.recursos: Manage external visual packs; Jobs already bundles its own assets.
jobsmenu.tooltip.accesibilidad: Open contrast, narrator, subtitles and visual assistance.
jobsmenu.tooltip.online: Control privacy, telemetry and online services.
jobsmenu.tooltip.fov: Change field of view without leaving the file.
jobsmenu.tooltip.servidor.directa: Connect once by entering an address.
jobsmenu.tooltip.servidor.agregar: Save another server to your list.
jobsmenu.tooltip.servidor.editar: Change the selected server name or address.
jobsmenu.tooltip.servidor.eliminar: Remove the selected server from your list.
jobsmenu.tooltip.servidor.actualizar: Refresh status and latency. Shortcut: F5.
jobsmenu.tooltip.servidor.protegido: The official server is pinned and cannot be edited or removed.
jobsmenu.nivel18.nota0: The red tear crosses a silhouette that does not match between frames.
jobsmenu.nivel18.nota1: The pale bands shift position even while the background stays still.
jobsmenu.nivel18.nota2: Do not follow the cyan trace; it ends inside the interference.
jobsmenu.nivel19.nota0: The red flare stays fixed inside a dark mass with no stable edge.
jobsmenu.nivel19.nota1: The violet haze makes distance and scale unreliable.
jobsmenu.nivel19.nota2: If the center opens again, do not use it as an orientation point.
jobsmenu.nivel20.nota0: The red figure hangs among black branches that share no single origin.
jobsmenu.nivel20.nota1: The ovals across its body repeat where none were visible before.
jobsmenu.nivel20.nota2: Do not separate the silhouette from the background; both change together.
jobsmenu.nivel21.nota0: More than one figure stands in the clearing; none answer signals.
jobsmenu.nivel21.nota1: Do not use the tall figure on the right as a scale reference.
jobsmenu.nivel21.nota2: Do not cross the tree line even when the center looks clear.
jobsmenu.nivel22.nota0: The distant figure remains still between the cave walls.
jobsmenu.nivel22.nota1: Do not use the rock face to estimate its height.
jobsmenu.nivel22.nota2: The route ends before the watcher; do not advance to measure the distance.
jobsmenu.nivel23.nota0: Black filaments surround the occupant without showing a single origin.
jobsmenu.nivel23.nota1: The lit blocks do not form a stable structure.
jobsmenu.nivel23.nota2: If the tangle appears to open a path, do not treat it as an exit.
jobsmenu.nivel24.nota0: The red arch is not listed as an operational access point.
jobsmenu.nivel24.nota1: The figure beside the threshold changes silhouette against the light.
jobsmenu.nivel24.nota2: Do not cross the center even when the glow weakens.
jobsmenu.nivel25.nombre: LEVEL 25 · The Signal Above the Forest
jobsmenu.nivel25.nota0: The pixelated form remains suspended above the forest.
jobsmenu.nivel25.nota1: The figure at the lower edge must not answer the signal.
jobsmenu.nivel25.nota2: Image faults continue even when the sky appears stable.
jobsmenu.nivel26.nota0: The presence remains on the white surface in front of the planet.
jobsmenu.nivel26.nota1: Its limbs cast shadows that do not agree with the light.
jobsmenu.nivel26.nota2: Keep the horizon edge as the observation limit.
jobsmenu.nivel27.nota0: The central structure dominates ground with no visible approach route.
jobsmenu.nivel27.nota1: The shapes in the sky are not facility signage.
jobsmenu.nivel27.nota2: If a window lights up, the building is still considered closed.
jobsmenu.nivel28.nota0: The red core appears fragmented into layers that keep no stable depth.
jobsmenu.nivel28.nota1: The surrounding blocks change position between readings.
jobsmenu.nivel28.nota2: Do not reconstruct the pattern by following the brightest pieces.
jobsmenu.nivel29.nota0: The entity fills most of the horizon before a single observer.
jobsmenu.nivel29.nota1: The red rings across its body are not signal lights.
jobsmenu.nivel29.nota2: If the filaments turn toward the edge, leave the observation point.
jobsmenu.nivel30.nota0: The hunched figure stands against broken horizontal red bands.
jobsmenu.nivel30.nota1: The black blocks are not fixed to the background.
jobsmenu.nivel30.nota2: Do not use the creature posture to estimate distance.
jobsmenu.nivel31.nota0: The central mass gathers red rings and suspended fragments.
jobsmenu.nivel31.nota1: The white and red cubes do not belong to the sector inventory.
jobsmenu.nivel31.nota2: If the silhouette covers the stars, end the observation.
